versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "finding-fitness-brands-on-tiktok" skill.
- Enables discovery of fitness studios, wellness brands, and gym businesses on TikTok via Apify's TikTok Scraper.
- Returns detailed video and channel info, engagement metrics, and hashtags for prospecting.
- Includes scoring and tier-based classification (PRIME_PROSPECT, WARM_LEAD, LOW_PRIORITY) for lead quality.
- Provides usage instructions for Node.js scripts and REST API, plus best practices and edge case tips.
